where: tools/dsc/verify_camp.sh step 4 (scope), branch claude/mmo-camp vs claude/mmo-overhaul
problem: The full gate does not print VERIFY PASS. It exits 1 with one line, 'FAIL out of scope: docs/orchestration/mmo/STATUS.md'. Every other step passes (18 kinds PASS, check_manifest, atlas and base-GLB hashes, t_structart, t_build, run_all, build_lab, smoke). The cause is base drift, not package content: overhaul gained f947c631 (a one-line STATUS.md entry) after the branch's last merge, and step 4 uses a two-dot 'git diff claude/mmo-overhaul', so anything new on overhaul counts as out of scope. With a three-dot diff (claude/mmo-overhaul...HEAD) step 4 reports nothing out of scope.
fix: Merge claude/mmo-overhaul into claude/mmo-camp again before the integrator runs the gate, or change step 4 to 'git diff --name-only claude/mmo-overhaul...HEAD' so later overhaul commits do not count against the package.

problem: In game (Forward+ and gl_compatibility) the ember/ash bed sits under the slab, so nothing reads as hot. From the iso camera the piece is a pale grey stone table with two red blocks (meat) and a fish on top. It reads as a stone bench more than a grill. The cool near-white stone is also the brightest value in the camp.
fix: Open the front of the firebox and put a visible ember strip in the mouth (or ember glow between the support stones on the camera side), char-darken the centre of the slab, and drop the stone albedo a step toward stone_dark.

problem: At game distance the bucket's water reads as a dark grey disc, so the bucket looks like a small stump with a handle (barrel water reads fine as teal). The cabin_bed boots beside the foot are two plain brown cubes and read as blocks, not boots.
fix: Use the same water tile and height as the barrel for the bucket, nearer the rim. Give each boot a toe and a shaft (two segments), or drop the boots.

where: game/scripts/world/build_grid.gd placement_transform (_mean_corner_height), affects field_small, field_large, straw_roll, bedroll (orchestration note, not this package's fault)
problem: Buildings are placed flat at the mean corner height, and MAX_SLOPE_SPREAD allows 0.6 m. On the steepest legal cells the probe measured the model bottom at -0.31..+0.25 m from the terrain under the corners for field_large, -0.28..+0.26 m for field_small, and about ±0.27 m for straw_roll and bedroll. These four now have no dirt disc, so on a slope one corner floats about 0.25 m and the opposite one is buried. It does not show on flat camp ground.
fix: Cursor: for low ground-hugging kinds, lower MAX_SLOPE_SPREAD (about 0.25 m), or place at the minimum corner height and add a short soil skirt. Alternatively, tilt the fields to the terrain normal.

problem: Unchanged since r1. 11 of the 18 new models (campfire_stand, technical_workbench, grindstone, tent_canvas, bedroll, large_box, barrel, bucket, fence_fortified, signpost, fishing_stand) have no kit or _spawn case, so players never see them. The report says so honestly.
fix: Orchestrator: give them kits and _spawn cases (Cursor), or record them as art-only.
